move: cursor clicks lens, bar expands, text types, results drop, collapses back
how: A round 64px search lens scales in with back.out(2). A cursor slides in and clicks at 20%; the bar widens to 720px with expo.out over 0.7s, a blue focus ring and glow shadow appear, and a caret blinks (opacity yoyo repeat 9). From 37% TextPlugin types the query over 0.7s, a clear button pops in, and at 46% a results panel drops (opacity, scaleY .8 to 1, expo.out) with three rows staggering up; the highlighted row flashes. From 80% the panel folds up, text clears and the bar collapses back to 64px with expo.inOut, placeholder returning at 97%.
adapt: Change the placeholder, the typed query and the result rows (bold the matching term); swap the accent blue; keep the 0.7s expo.out expand and the collapse timing.
port: mount(el, shot) builds bar, results and cursor from shot.query/shot.results; animate returns the timeline with the click at 0.2D, typing at 0.37D and collapse at 0.86D. The cursor path uses stage coordinates so express them relative to el; TextPlugin must be registered.
caveats: cursor positions assume a 720px wrap centred on a 1280x720 stage
